newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Sept retail sales value down 1.4pct m/m-CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish Sept retail sales value down 1.4pct m/m-CSO.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales fell a provisional seasonally adjusted 1.4 percent in September, giving a year-on-year increase of 5.1 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed.
In August, the value of sales fell a final 0.4 percent m/m for a final year-on-year rise of 7.2 percent. These were revised from a provisional -0.5 pct m/m and 7.1 pct y/y.
Sales volume in August was down 0.6 percent on July and was 5.1 percent higher than in August last year.
